definitions.full: H5696. agol עָגוֺל עָגֹל, adjective round ; — absolute עָגֹל 1Kin 7:23 2 t., עָגוֺל 10:19 ; 2Chr 4:2 ; feminine plural עֲגֻלּוֺת 1Kin 7:31 ; — round 7:31 (twice in verse) (opposed to מְרֻבָּעוֺת ), 10:19 ; ׳ע סָבְיב round in circuit (perimeter) 7:23 2Chr 4:2 ; 1Kin 7:35 .
definitions.rootNote: or עָגוֹל ; from an unused root meaning to revolve ,
